g.text: Figure 5b - Sequence Diagram: Failure Paths of GEN-02 "Journal Exception Attribution" (hybrid) in one A6 Instance
Failure branches F-1 to F-5 (14) modelled as nested alt fragments: a failing branch simply does not enter the computation below it,
and every branch - failing or not - returns through the same StatePatch to A1
Main line: rule stage and context assembly
hybrid pre-filter: the exceptions raised by the GEN-05 full journal scan
(rule stage, no reasoning chain, no A7)
assemble the four context layers per 8.5
(system, standards, task, data); EngagementState itself never enters the prompt
F-3 / F-1 / F-2 / F-4: one nested alt, nothing is written outside the patch
[F-3b a single batch is still over context_budget (8.5)]
no LLM call is made; ProcedureRun -> failed,
log(context over budget, no LLM call made)
one ReviewTask draft of kind = failed in the patch. No Judgment exists, so the
validation levels and F-4 below are never entered.
Human narrows the scope (rerun + rerunParams) or performs it (manual_result);
scope_limited / not_applicable also allowed (UC-04 failed row).
split into batches, never truncate; one call per batch,
one Judgment per Exception, no context shared between batches
log(llm_call: model version, prompt, input hash, params, batchNo)
Evidence coverage (8.4) is computed per batch; cross-batch aggregation
is done by rules, not by the LLM. Everything below is drawn for one call
[the context fits in a single call]
log(llm_call: model version, prompt, input hash, params)
[F-1 LLM endpoint times out or is rate limited (14)]
still failing -> the call is queued for a later window (14)
and keeps the rule result, Exception.disposition = unattributed; engine =
result to fall back on -> ProcedureRun -> failed, failureReason = llm_unavailable
into the StatePatch; kind = failed, target = ProcedureRun when engine = llm
- Procedure awaiting_human, no Judgment either way,
so validation and F-4 are never entered.
hybrid: rule result kept, Exception unattributed, ReviewTask draft kind = unattributed;
allowed decisions override / misstatement / more_procedures (UC-04), confirm is refused,
an unattributed exception is not a disposition.
engine = llm: ProcedureRun failed (llm_unavailable), ReviewTask draft kind = failed;
allowed decisions rerun / manual_result / scope_limited / not_applicable.
[F-2a syntax or structure violates output_schema, 2 retries exhausted (8.6 levels 1-2)]
[at most 2 retries, parse error handed back]
retries exhausted, no valid Judgment object
into the StatePatch; kind = failed, target = ProcedureRun when engine = llm
- Procedure awaiting_human; hybrid: rule result kept,
Exception unattributed, ReviewTask draft kind = unattributed.
engine = llm: ProcedureRun failed, ReviewTask draft kind = failed.
No Judgment exists, so F-4 is never entered.
validateReferences: sourceId exists, amount matches the entry,
Judgment continues with reduced evidence coverage
no ReviewTask draft of its own; it continues into F-4 below.
the whole Judgment is degraded to the human queue (7.4)
ReviewTask draft kind = normal; it still passes through F-4 below.
validateSemantics: reasoning chain non-empty, every fact carries a pointer,
every inference cites a previous step, confidence within 0..1,
suggested action agrees with the conclusion
- Judgment kept and flagged, Procedure awaiting_human,
ReviewTask draft kind = normal. Whether the evidence supports the
conclusion is re-derived by A7 under GEN-09 (8.6 level 4).
[F-4 GEN-09 trigger hit on this Judgment and A7 still inconsistent after Loop 1 (11, UC-03)]
[Loop 1: loop1Rounds < 3 and new system-internal evidence found]
re-generate, re-validate (8.6), A7 re-compares; old Judgment -> supersededBy
final Judgment flagged dispute, disputeRounds recorded;
A6 conclusion and A7 independent conclusion kept side by side with both chains
into the StatePatch -> adjudication lane, no confidence ranking, no blind
(not a settled state, blocks FIN-05), ReviewTask draft kind = dispute.
Only decision allowed: dispute_resolution = a6_upheld / a7_upheld / neither
[GEN-09 not hit, or the verdict is consistent]
- no dispute; the effective level from the common step below
decides the landing: L1 / L2 / blind / 9.1 mandatory rows draft a ReviewTask
kind = normal; L3 normal items and L4 close automatically, Procedure -> completed
(9.2 still samples 5% as kind = blind). All of it stays in the patch.
apply 7.4 downgrade rules and compute confidence (8.4) for every kept
F-5 Fan-in: one return path for every branch above (8.6 agent layer, 14)
Failure results travel back exactly like successful ones: the instance writes
nothing to AuditOutputStore or ReviewQueue itself (18.4). Everything above is
a draft until A1 has merged it; business results reach AuditOutputStore only
through A1, after the merge has passed.
mergePatch: four checks (8.6 agent layer) - write scope (18.3.1),
type, ID uniqueness, foreign key (Judgment -> procedure_pack)
every ProcedureRun in the patch -> failed, failureReason = patch_rejected;
the drafts both patches carried are discarded with them
publish(one ReviewTask kind = failed per ProcedureRun)
- Procedure awaiting_human. This is the only case in which A1 creates a
ReviewTask itself (the system failed to execute it); everywhere else A6 drafts the task
Allowed decisions: rerun / manual_result / scope_limited / not_applicable (UC-04).
[the re-run patch passes the four checks]
publish(ReviewTask drafts from the re-run patch)
- the same landing as a first-attempt pass: one extra ProcedureRun
for the re-run, nothing failed. Business Store first, checkpoint after (18.5).
[all four checks pass on the first patch]
The drafts become visible to the human only at this point. A task the user can
see is therefore always a task whose state A1 has already accepted.
[F-5b the instance crashed or timed out, no StatePatch at all]
nothing returns from fw-L-i: re-schedule its remaining procedures to other
instances (grouping is an optimisation, not a constraint); Judgments already
merged from its earlier patches are kept
log(schedule change; the schedule table is deterministic, no LLM)
- no ReviewTask at all and nothing written for this execution;
the remaining procedures stay planned and re-enter executing under another
instance with a new ProcedureRun. The human is never notified.
Main line: every branch that needs a human ends in the same queue (details in Figure 4a)
[a published ReviewTask exists for this procedure]
Entered only for tasks the merge actually published. Results that closed
automatically and were not sampled (9.2), and the silent re-scheduling of F-5b,
publish no task and expect no human decision.
present(task) with the decisions allowed for its kind:
reasoning chain and evidence, or rule result (unattributed),
or failure reason (failed), or scope request (scope_limited)
whole object built verbatim from the form fields, no LLM
write(ReviewRecord), recompute Procedure status: completed only when every
ReviewTask is decided, no open dispute, no follow-up run pending and the period is covered
(timing != interim or periodCovered); otherwise awaiting_human / in_dispute / executing / interim_completed
hybrid: rule result kept, Exception unattributed, draft kind unattributed; engine = llm: ProcedureRun failed (llm_unavailable), draft kind failed; Procedure awaiting_human
same engine fallback as F-1 (hybrid unattributed, llm failed)
some valid: step flagged unsupported and kept, Judgment continues; none valid: Judgment kept, draft kind normal
semantic validation fails (chain, pointers, confidence, action)
Judgment kept and degraded per 7.4, draft kind normal, Procedure awaiting_human
batched calls with batchNo; a single batch still over -> ProcedureRun failed (needs_manual_scope), draft kind failed
Judgment flagged dispute, draft kind dispute, Procedure in_dispute
merge checks fail, or no patch returns at all
patch received: checks, one re-run, then pass (merge, write, publish) or fail (runs failed, A1 publishes failed tasks); no patch: silent re-scheduling
states what a branch leaves behind - ProcedureRun, Procedure and the kind of any ReviewTask draft.
It is not a stop: failure results still travel back to A1 in the StatePatch, and the nesting of the alt fragments is what
keeps a failed branch out of the validation, F-4 and confidence steps below it. ReviewTasks become visible to the human
only after A1 has merged the patch (18.4): A6 drafts them, A1 publishes them, and a patch rejected twice publishes none
of its drafts - only the failed tasks A1 creates itself. Business results (Judgments, Exceptions, ProcedureRuns) are
written to AuditOutputStore by A1 after the merge, never by the instance or the JudgmentEngine.
The opt at the bottom marks the human lane as conditional: it is entered only for a task the merge published, so an
automatic close that was not sampled and a silent re-scheduling (F-5b) end the execution without any human step.
Every LLM call, retry and failure writes one AuditTrail line (M-07); retry, degradation and timeout are
implemented inside the node, not left to framework defaults (18.5).
A1, A5 and A9 never call the LLM. A6 -> A7 is the only direct agent-to-agent call; every other exchange
travels as a StatePatch through A1. The human talks only to A10, and A10 writes only through DecisionSubmit.
